baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Use the pinned Cartog source snapshot from retrieval-cartog-codex-product-v2 and install every product-authored Claude Code surface it documents (MCP, hooks, skills, plugins, rules, and guidance) into the lane-private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Require provider-free artifact, configuration, and handshake proofs before any Anthropic request.

reset.policy: Delete the lane-private Claude config, tool state, indexes, generated guidance, hooks, plugins, and background processes after evidence capture; retain only immutable run artifacts and source hashes.

evaluation_protocol.instruction_policy: product-authored guidance only; no evaluator-authored invocation steering
evaluation_protocol.assignment_proof: provider-free pinned source, exact Claude configuration, native activation, and required MCP/hooks/skills/plugin smoke checks

registry_entry.notes: Claude Code preparation profile for Cartog; source profile retrieval-cartog-codex-product-v2. Provider-free native qualification passed for both Lifecycle V1 sequences, which were the active pair at the time; provider execution is governed by the owner authorization and first-valid-sample policy.
